customer_message.subject: Heating defect in rented flat at Kirchgasse 57, Zug
customer_message.body: hi, I'm writing about my flat at Kirchgasse 57 in Zug, the 3-room flat I rent from Peter Ammann (private landlord) / the heating has not been working properly since the start of September / some rooms stay cold and several radiators simply fail to heat up / in the mornings the flat cools down to about 16 degrees, which is not acceptable for a rented flat / I reported this to Mr Ammann by text message on 3 September and asked him to send someone to fix it / he has not fixed it yet and has not given me a date either / I don't want to just sit and wait / if the defect is not fixed, I intend to pay my rent into the official rent deposit (Hinterlegung) so that I am not in default while this gets sorted out / before I do that I want to understand the correct steps and what my legal expenses cover / can you help me with this? I can send you the text messages and photos of the radiators if that helps / thanks, Sam
